Hi team and Alex —

Thanks again for signing! A few operational items to get Alex over the finish line and make week one smooth. Quick checklist and asks below:

- Alex: please authorize the background/employment verification vendor (Sterling) — I'll send the portal link in a follow-up.
- HR (Marissa): can you kick off the I-9 and employment-verification forms? We need proof of prior employment for the 2 most recent roles (per our policy).
- Monica / Aditya: confirmed start date proposal is Monday, 2026-09-06 — please confirm.
- Ops (Karthik): please reserve a laptop + dock and confirm shipping address.
- Alex: please reply with a scanned government ID (passport or driver's license) and the address where you want the kit shipped; t-shirt size if you want swag.

Attachments: signed_offer_agreement.pdf (Alex, you sent this back last night — included for reference).

Goal: have verification initiated and laptop reserved by end of day Wednesday (Aug 5) so IT can target a shipment the week of Aug 24 for arrival before orientation.

Thanks — I'm happy to own coordination unless someone else prefers it.

Best,

Hi Alex — welcome!

Got your ID and address, thank you — received alex_id_scan.pdf. I started the verification request with Sterling and they created your portal: https://sterling.com/onboarding/portal/ABC-1234 (link valid for 7 days). You should receive an email from no-reply@sterling.com with a unique authentication code — please complete the portal steps as soon as possible so we can hit our timeline.

I attached the HR preboarding checklist and the welcome packet (hr_preboarding_checklist.pdf, welcome_packet.pdf). The checklist includes the exact docs Sterling will request and how to provide manager contacts if needed. Quick answers to your questions:

- First week: primarily remote. We have an optional in-person lunch in SF the Friday of week one (attendance optional). Your buddy will coordinate daily check-ins the first week.
- Materials to review: short reading list in the welcome packet (product overview, PR guidelines, runbook links). Aim to skim those the week before.

Karthik — please confirm laptop model and tentative ship date. Ops, I flagged asset provisioning for expedited processing.

If anyone on the internal thread has additional asks (VPN access, special software licenses), reply-all and I'll track them.

Best,
